blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model’s hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures ( discrimination ); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies ( calibration ); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing ( utility ). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.
blocks.zh: 生成前的成功探测器从一个语言模型的隐藏活化器中估算出响应正确性后再去解码,从而能够有成本意识的路由. 虽然先前的工作已经表明它们主要对英语投入的有用性,但我们在三个方面研究了不同语言的可靠性:(1) 它们是否保持对可能成败的排名(歧视);(2) 它们是否保留与观察到的成功频率相匹配的概率(校正);和(3) 它们是否为成本-认知多语种路由(效用)的候选模式提供了足够可比的分数。 我们利用10种语言的3000个MATH问题和8个开放量模型配置,比较了从英语训练的探测器和平预算集合多语言探测器的交叉语言转移. 接受过英语训练的探针保留了有用的跨语言歧视,但转会后校正程度降低. 集中多语种监督既能改善特性,又能产生更可靠的成功估计。 在路由实验中,集合路由器实现了0.7%的测试成功率,同时相对于总选择平均成功率最高的模型,将模型成本降低13.0%. 这些结果表明,多语种的路由需要成功的估计,这些估计仍然有很好的校正,而且各语文和模型之间可以比较。

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) do not perform consistently across languages. A model may solve a mathematical problem in English and fail on a semantically equivalent formulation in another language ( Shi et al., 2022 ; Ahuja et al., 2023 ; Ko et al., 2025 ; Son et al., 2025 ) . At the same time, always using the strongest available model is costly and often unnecessary, since a cheaper model may be equally capable of solving the same problem ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Aggarwal et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2024 ) . Cost-aware model routing aims to address this trade-off by selecting, for each input, the least expensive model likely to produce a correct response. Such a decision requires estimating, before decoding, how likely each candidate model is to answer correctly.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在跨语言中的表现不一致. 一个模型可以解决英语中的数学问题,在另一种语言的分泌等同配方上失败(Shi等,2022;Ahuja等,2023;Ko等,2025;Son等,2025.). 与此同时,总是使用最强的可用模型是昂贵的,而且常常是不必要的,因为更便宜的模型可能同样能够解决同样的问题(Chen等,2023;Aggarwal等,2024;Chen等,2024;Ong等,2024)。 成本认识模式的路由旨在解决这种取舍,为每项投入选择成本最低的、可能产生正确反应的模式。 这种决定要求在解码前估计每个候选人模式有多么可能正确回答。

blocks.en: Recent work has shown that a model’s hidden activations contain information about the correctness of its future response ( Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ; Lugoloobi et al., 2026 ) . Linear probes can extract this information after the prompt has been processed but before the first output token is generated. These pre-generation success probes can therefore support routing without first generating and evaluating a candidate response ( Di Cicco, 2026 ; Lugoloobi et al., 2026 ; Varshney et al., 2026 ) . However, existing evidence is largely limited to English inputs, leaving unclear whether these probes remain reliable across languages and whether their estimates are sufficiently comparable for multilingual routing. We therefore ask: (RQ1) How reliably do pre-generation success probes transfer from English to non-English target languages? (RQ2) How effectively do the resulting success estimates support cost-aware routing?
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,一个模型的隐藏活化包含关于其未来反应正确性的信息(Azaria and Mitchell, 2023;Lugoloobi等, 2026). 线性探测器可以在及时处理完毕后,但在生成第一个输出令牌之前取出这些信息. 因此,这些出产前的成功探测器可以支持去向,而不首先生成和评价候选反应(Di Cicco, 2026;Lugoloobi等, 2026;Varshney等, 2026). 然而,现有证据基本上仅限于英文投入,因此尚不清楚这些探测器在各种语文中是否仍然可靠,其估计数字是否足以与多语种路由进行比较。 因此,我们问:(RQ1) 如何可靠地使产生前的成功探测从英语转移到非英语的目标语言? (RQ2) 由此产生的成功估计如何有效地支持成本意识的路由?

blocks.en:
We investigate these questions using 3,000 problems from the MATH dataset ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , translated from English into 9 additional languages, and 8 open-weight model configurations. For each problem, language, and model configuration, we collect n = 5 n=5 sampled generations to estimate empirical success and extract residual-stream activations at every model depth before decoding. We train layer-wise ridge-regression probes under monolingual training and equal-budget pooled multilingual training. We then compare English-to-target cross-lingual transfer with pooled multilingual supervision, using a probe trained directly on labelled data in the target language as an oracle reference.
We assess probes’ reliability through three increasingly demanding requirements: (1) probes should preserve the ordering of likely successes and failures ( discrimination ); (2) their predicted probabilities should remain aligned with observed success frequencies ( calibration ); and (3) their scores should be sufficiently comparable across candidate models to support effective cost-aware choices ( utility ).
blocks.zh:
我们用MATH数据集的3000个问题(Hendrycks等,2021年)来调查这些问题,从英语翻译成了9个额外的语言,还有8个开量模型配置. 对于每个问题,语言,和模型配置,我们收集n=5n=5被采样的代来估计经验成功率,并提取每个模型深度的剩余流活性后再解码. 我们通过单一语言培训和同等预算的集合多语种培训,对山脊后退探测器进行分层培训。 然后,我们将英语与目标交叉语言的调用与集合多语种的监管进行比较,使用直接以目标语言标注数据的探测器作为甲骨文参考。
我们通过三项日益严格的要求来评估探测器的可靠性:(1) 探测器应保持对可能的成功和失败(歧视)的顺序;(2) 探测器的预测概率应与观察到的成功频率(校正)保持一致;(3) 探测器的分数应在候选模型中具有充分的可比性,以支持有效的成本意识选择(效用)。

blocks.en: Our results show that English-trained probes retain substantial cross-lingual discrimination, particularly at intermediate layers ( Civelli et al., 2026 ) . Their scores, however, do not retain a consistent probabilistic meaning across languages. Pooled multilingual supervision reduces expected calibration error by 38–69% across models and produces a stronger success–cost frontier in routing (see Figure 1 ). Overall, our findings show that preserving cross-lingual rankings is only one requirement for reliable multilingual routing. Effective routing also requires success probabilities whose scale remains meaningful across languages and sufficiently comparable across candidate models.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,经英语训练的探测器保留了大量的跨语言歧视,特别是在中间层(Civelli等人,2026年)。 然而,他们的分数并没有在各种语言之间保持一贯的概率意义. 多语种监管将预计校正误差减少38-69%,并在路由方面产生更大的成功-成本前沿(见图1)。 总体而言,我们的调查结果表明,保持跨语种排名只是可靠的多语种路由的一项要求。 有效的路由也需要成功的概率,其规模在各种语文之间仍然有意义,在候选模式之间有足够的可比性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work has investigated whether a model’s internal state contains information about properties of its eventual response before generation begins. Early studies identify activation patterns associated with truthfulness and correctness ( Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ) . Related work shows that human-annotated problem difficulty is linearly decodable from pre-generation representations ( Lugoloobi and Russell, 2025 ; Civelli et al., 2026 ) . Moving from these general response and problem-level properties to model-specific success, Cencerrado et al. (2025) estimate forthcoming answer correctness from question-only activations by constructing correctness directions from the difference between the mean activations of successful and unsuccessful examples. These directions transfer well across factual knowledge tasks, but their predictive performance is weaker on mathematical reasoning. Lugoloobi et al. (2026) extend this line of work by training supervised linear probes directly on labelled successes and failures. They show that these probes can predict model success on mathematical and coding tasks and, crucially, use the resulting estimates for cost-aware model routing. Subsequent approaches similarly exploit prefilling-time signals for self-evaluation ( Kasnavieh et al., 2026 ) or use an open-weight model’s activations to predict the correctness of separate target models for routing ( Varshney et al., 2026 ) . Together, these studies establish that pre-generation representations encode signals correlated with correctness and that these signals can support routing decisions.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作调查了模型的内部状态是否包含在开始生成前其最终反应的属性信息. 早期研究查明了与真实性和正确性有关的激活模式(Azaria和Mitchell,2023年)。 相关工作显示,人类附加说明的问题难度从出世前的表示(Lugoloobi and Russell, 2025; Civelli等, 2026)可线性解码. Cencerrado等人(2025年)从这些一般的响应和问题层面的属性转向模型特定的成功,通过从成功和不成功实例的平均激活之间的差别构建正确性方向,从仅提问激活中估算出即将出现的答案正确性. 这些方向在事实知识任务之间传递很强,但其预测性能在数学推理上较弱. Lugoloobi等人(2026年)通过直接培训有监督的线性探测器来扩展这项工作。 它们表明,这些探测器可以预测数学和编码任务的模型成功,并且关键是使用由此得出的成本意识模型路由估计. 后续方法同样利用预填时间信号进行自我评价(Kasnavieh等,2026年),或使用开放式模型的活化来预测单独目标模型的正确性(Varshney等,2026年). 这些研究共同确定,生成前的表示式将信号编码与正确性相关,这些信号可以支持路由决定.

blocks.en: Multilingual models have been shown to map semantically equivalent inputs in different languages to partially aligned representation spaces Bernardelle et al. (2026) ; Kim and Lee (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Schut et al. (2025) ; Wendler et al. (2024) , enabling zero-shot cross-lingual transfer ( Pires et al., 2019 ; Conneau et al., 2020 ; Libovický et al., 2020 ) . Nevertheless, multilingual representation differences in tokenisation, pretraining data, and language-specific model competence can produce substantial variation across languages ( Rust et al., 2021 ) . Moreover, representational alignment alone does not guarantee that task-relevant information will transfer. In a controlled multilingual setting, Hua et al. (2024) show that strongly aligned representations can coexist with poor cross-lingual transfer, demonstrating that shared geometry is not sufficient for transferring a learned predictor. This distinction is particularly important for meta-cognitive signals. Concurrent work finds that problem difficulty has a partly shared cross-lingual geometry, especially in intermediate model layers ( Civelli et al., 2026 ) . Similarly, Datta et al. (2026) report that activation-based hallucination detectors trained in English deteriorate under zero-shot cross-lingual transfer and benefit from multilingual supervision.
blocks.zh: 多语种模型被显示为将不同语言的等效输入映射到部分对齐的Bernardelle等人(2026年);Kim和Lee(2025年);Li等(2025年);Schut等(2025年);Wendler等(2024年),实现零射入跨语相传(Pires等,2019年;Conneau等,2020年;Libovický等,2020年). 尽管如此,多语种在标志化、培训前数据和语言特有示范能力方面的表现差异,可产生各语言之间的巨大差异(Rust等人,2021年)。 此外,仅靠代表协调并不能保证与任务有关的信息能够转移。 在受控多语种环境中,Hua等人(2024年)表示,高度一致的表示可以与较差的跨语言转移并存,表明共享几何并不足以传输所学的预测器. 这种区分对于元能识别信号特别重要. 同时期工作发现,问题难度有部分共享的跨语言几何,特别是在中间模型层(Civelli等,2026. 同样地,Datta等人(2026年)报告说,英语培训的基于活化的幻觉探测器在零射交叉语言传输下恶化并受益于多语种监督.

blocks.en:
Discrimination and calibration describe complementary properties of a predictor. A predictor may rank successful examples above unsuccessful ones while assigning scores that do not correspond to empirical outcome frequencies ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Zadrozny and Elkan, 2002 ; Naeini et al., 2015 ; Platt, 1999 ) .
Prior work has shown that cross-lingual transfer can substantially degrade the calibration of output-level predictions ( Jiang et al., 2022 ) . More recently, Zhou et al. (2025) study multilingual confidence signals in internal representations and find that intermediate layers can provide better-calibrated confidence estimates than final-layer representations, particularly outside English. This result connects multilingual calibration to representational depth, but does not establish whether supervised pre-generation success probes preserve calibration when transferred between languages or whether multilingual supervision improves their downstream routing utility.
blocks.zh:
区别和校正描述一个预测器的互补特性. 一个预测者可能将成功事例排在不成功事例之上,同时分配与经验结果频率不符的分数(Guo等,2017;Zadrozny和Elkan,2002;Naeini等,2015;Platt,1999)。
先前的研究表明,跨语言的转移可大幅度地降低产出水平预测的校正(Jiang等,2022年)。 最近出自"周书"等. (2025年)研究内部代表物中的多语种信任信号,并发现中间层可以提供比最终层代表物更好的校正信任估计,特别是英语以外的. 这一结果将多语种校正与代表深度联系起来,但并未确定在语言间传输时,受监督的出厂前成功探测器是否保持了校正,也未能确定多语种校正是否改善了其下游通路功能.

blocks.en: LLM routing and cascading seek to reduce inference cost by assigning each query to the least expensive model expected to answer it correctly ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Ong et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2024 ; Dekoninck et al., 2025 ; Jitkrittum et al., 2025 ) . Most routing methods estimate model suitability from external signals such as query embeddings, preference data, previously observed outputs, or uncertainty measures. Activation-based routers instead use internal representations computed during prompt prefilling to estimate model-specific success before generation begins ( Lugoloobi et al., 2026 ; Varshney et al., 2026 ) . For routing, however, predictive ranking alone may be insufficient. Model scores must be comparable across candidate models and operating conditions if they are used to set thresholds or optimise expected success under a cost constraint.
blocks.zh: LLM 路由和分层法试图通过将每个查询分配到预期能正确回答它的最廉价模型来降低推论成本(Chen等,2023;Ong等,2024;Ding等,2024;Dekoninck等,2025;Jitkrittum等,2025)。 大多数路由方法估计模型是否适合来自外部信号,如查询嵌入,偏好数据,以前观察到的输出,或不确定度量. 以活化为主的路由器则使用在迅速预填过程中所计算的内部表示,在开始生成前估计模型特定的成功(Lugoloobi等,2026;Varshney等,2026)。 然而,就路线而言,仅预测排名可能是不够的。 模型得分必须具有候选人模型和操作条件的可比性,如果在成本限制下用于设定阈值或优化预期成功。

blocks.en: Existing activation-based routing work has not examined whether success estimates or routing thresholds remain valid under language shift.
blocks.zh: 现有的基于激活的路由工作尚未审查在语言转换中成功估计值或路由阈值是否仍然有效。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据

blocks.en:
We sample 3,000 English-language problems from the MATH dataset ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) and translate each into Arabic, Chinese, French, Italian, Russian, Swahili, Telugu, Thai, and Turkish using DeepL ( DeepL SE, 2026 ) .
To preserve the mathematical content and structure of the source problems, we protect mathematical notation and structured blocks during translation. We apply regular-expression checks to detect malformed notation, and use COMET-Kiwi ( Rei et al., 2022 ) as a reference-free estimate of translation adequacy. For further details on translation quality see Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
我们从MATH数据集(Hendrycks等,2021年)中抽取了3000个英语问题,并使用DeepL(DeepL SE,2026年)将每个问题翻译成阿拉伯文、中文、法文、意大利文、俄文、斯瓦希里文、泰文古文和土耳其文。
为了保存源问题的数学内容和结构,我们在翻译过程中保护了数学符号和结构块. 我们采用常规表达式检查来检测错误的标记,并使用Comet-Kiwi(Rei等,2022年)作为翻译是否充分的无参考估计. 关于翻译质量的进一步详情,见附录A。

blocks.en: We partition the 3,000 underlying MATH problems into training, validation, and test sets using a 70/15/15 split. We split by underlying problem rather than by translated prompt, so all ten language-specific versions of a problem remain in the same partition, with the resulting assignment shared across all models. The training split is used to fit probe parameters, the validation split is used for regularisation, reporting-layer, recalibration, and routing-policy selection, and the test split is reserved for final evaluation.

blocks.en: 3.6 Cross-lingual Probe Reliability
blocks.zh: 3.6 跨文化 勘探可靠性

blocks.en: To answer RQ1 , we evaluate probe quality on the same held-out examples from each of the nine non-English target languages. Excluding English ensures that all reported comparisons measure performance under language transfer.
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ1,我们用9个非英语目标语言中每个语言中相同的被搁置实例来评价探测质量. 除去英文后,所有报告的比较都能够衡量语文转移项下的业绩。

blocks.en: We compare three regimes: (a) English transfer ( Eng. ) , where a probe trained under monolingual supervision on English is applied to the target language; (b) pooled multilingual supervision ( Pool ) , where a probe trained under pooled multilingual supervision is evaluated separately on each target language; and (c) same-language reference ( Oracle ) , where a probe trained under monolingual supervision in the target language is evaluated on that language. The oracle therefore uses labelled target-language training data and serves as a reference for the other two conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三种制度:(a)英语调用(英语),在英语单一语言监督下训练的探测器适用于目标语言;(b)集合多语种监督(Pool),在集合多语种监督下训练的探测器分别对每种目标语言进行评价;(c)同语参考(甲骨文),在单一语言监督下训练的探测器以该语言进行评价。 因此,甲骨文使用标有标记的目标语言培训数据,并作为其他两个条件的参考。

blocks.en: We evaluate discrimination using rollout-weighted AUROC. A problem with k i k_{i} successful and n i − k i n_{i}-k_{i} failed generations contributes its score p ^ i \widehat{p}_{i} with weight k i k_{i} to the positive class and weight n i − k i n_{i}-k_{i} to the negative class. AUROC therefore measures the probability that a randomly selected successful rollout receives a higher score than a randomly selected failed rollout.
blocks.zh: 我们通过推出加权的AUROC评估歧视。 ki k_{i} 成功和ni- ki_{i}- k_{i}i} 失败的几代人贡献其分数 p ^ i\ gladhat{p}_{i} 有重量的 ki k_{i}i} 为正分和分数 ni- ki_{i} 为负分. 因此,AUROC衡量随机选择的成功推出获得比随机选择失败推出更高的分数的概率.

blocks.en: AUROC depends only on the ordering of predictions and is invariant to strictly monotonic transformations of their values. A probe can therefore achieve high AUROC while being systematically overconfident or underconfident.
blocks.zh: AUROC只取决于预测的顺序,而且对其数值严格来说是单调性地转换的. 因此,探测器可以在系统性地过度自信或缺乏信心的情况下实现高AUROC.

blocks.en:
Calibration measures whether predicted probabilities agree with observed success frequencies.
We diagnose this using sample-weighted Expected Calibration Error (ECE) with ten equal-width bins and reliability diagrams. ECE summarizes the average absolute difference between predicted and observed success rates across bins, while reliability diagrams show where these differences occur.
blocks.zh:
校准测量,预测概率是否与观察到的成功频率一致.
我们用抽样加权的预期校正出错(ECE) 和10个等宽的盒子和可靠性图来判断。 欧洲经委会总结了各垃圾箱预测成功率和观察到的成功率之间的平均绝对差异,而可靠性图则显示这些差异的发生地。

blocks.en: Calibration does not measure whether a probe meaningfully separates easy and difficult problems. For example, a probe that always predicts the overall success rate may be perfectly calibrated while having no discriminative ability.
blocks.zh: 校正并不能衡量探测器是否有意义地将容易和困难的问题分开。 例如,一个总是预测总体成功率的探测器可能在没有歧视能力的情况下被完美地校准.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the overall quality of the predicted success probabilities using the rollout-level Brier score in Equation 3 and aggregated binomial negative log-likelihood (NLL). Both are strictly proper scoring rules: in expectation, they are minimized by reporting the true success probability. They jointly reward predictions that are correctly scaled and informative.
Brier score applies a quadratic penalty to probability errors and is bounded, whereas NLL applies a logarithmic penalty and therefore penalizes confidently incorrect predictions more strongly.
blocks.zh:
我们利用"方程式3"中推出的"Brier"级分数和"总的"二相负对数"(NLL)来评价预测成功概率的整体质量. 两者都是严格的适当的评分规则:在期望中,通过报告真正的成功概率,将二者降到最低。 它们共同奖励正确规模和资料丰富的预测。
Brier分数对概率误差适用四重罚并被定界,而NLL则采用对数罚并因此对自信地不正确的预测进行更严厉的惩罚.

blocks.en: Neither metric isolates calibration from discrimination: an improvement may result from a better probability scale, a better ordering of examples, or both. We consequently use AUROC to measure discrimination, calibration diagnostics to evaluate probability scale, and Brier score and NLL to summarize their combined effect on probability quality (more details can be found in Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 两者都无法将校正与歧视区分开来:改进可能来自更精确的概率尺度、更好的实例排序,或两者兼而有之。 因此,我们使用AUROC来衡量歧视,校准诊断来评价概率尺度,而Brier分数和NLL则总结其对概率质量的综合影响(详见附录C)。

Our main analysis uses encoder–target decoupled routing (ETD) Varshney et al. blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
Before evaluating probe discrimination , calibration , and routing utility , we first examine the extent to which model success varies across prompt languages. For Qwen3-4B , the empirical success rate ranges from 0.145 in Swahili to 0.716 in English (refer to Table 1 ), showing that success depends jointly on the mathematical problem, the evaluated model, and the language in which the problem is presented.
Similar cross-lingual variation is observed across the other evaluated models, with complete model-by-language success rates reported in Table 9 . A useful multilingual probe must therefore recover a model- and language-conditional success signal.
blocks.zh:
我们首先审查不同语言模式的成功程度。 对于Quen3-4B,经验性的成功率从斯瓦希里语的0.145到英语的0.716(参见表1)不等,表明成功与否共同取决于数学问题,评价模型,以及问题表述的语言.
在其他评价模型中也观察到类似的跨语种差异,表9报告了完整的逐语模型成功率。 因此,有用的多语种探测器必须恢复模型和语言条件的成功信号。

blocks.en: We subsequently evaluate whether English-trained probes preserve this ordering across languages, whether their predictions remain probabilistically calibrated, and whether they support effective cost-aware routing. Probe-quality results are macro-averaged over the nine non-English target languages, whereas routing is evaluated over all ten languages, including English. Throughout this section, we report Qwen3-4B as the representative model; the corresponding results for all other tested models exhibit consistent trends and are reported in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 我们随后评价了英语训练的探测器是否保留了这种跨语言的订单,其预测是否仍然有可能校准,以及它们是否支持有效的成本意识路由. 探测质量的结果在9种非英语目标语言中是宏观平均的,而路线则在所有10种语言中进行评价,包括英语。 在本节中,我们报告Qune3-4B为代表性模型;所有其他测试模型的相应结果呈现出一致的趋势,并在附录F中报告。

blocks.en: (b) Pooled multilingual

blocks.en: Table 2: Self-probe quality for Qwen3-4B at the shared reporting layer (L23). Values are macro-averages over the nine non-English test languages. AUROC treats the five rollouts as weighted binary outcomes.
blocks.zh: 表2:共享报告层(L23)中Quen3-4B的自测质量. 数值是9种非英语测试语言的宏观平均值. AUROC将这5个推出视为加权二进制结果.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that the English-trained Qwen3-4B probe retains substantial discrimination when transferred unchanged to the nine non-English languages. It achieves a macro-average rollout AUROC of 0.729, only 2.9 percentage points below the 0.758 obtained by probes trained directly in each evaluation language ( oracle ). Thus, English supervision retains enough success-relevant information to preserve much of the ordering between more and less likely successes after language shift.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,英语训练的Quen3-4B探测器在无变化地转移到9种非英语语言时保留了实质性的区别. 它的宏观平均推出AUROC为0.729,比直接接受每种评价语言(甲骨文)训练的探测器获得的0.758少了2.9个百分点。 因此,英语监督保留了足够的与成功有关的信息,以便在语言转换后保留更多的成功和更少的成功之间的顺序。

blocks.en: Equal-budget pooled multilingual supervision further increases AUROC to 0.741, reducing the gap to the same-language reference from 2.9 to 1.7 percentage points. Because the English and pooled conditions both use 2,100 training prompts, this improvement results from the linguistic composition of the supervision rather than a larger annotation budget. The pattern is consistent across all 8 model configurations (refer to Table 10 ). Pooled supervision improves AUROC for every configuration and raises the cross-model mean from 0.697 to 0.724, thereby reducing the average gap to the same-language reference from 4.9 to 2.2 percentage points. Cross-lingual ranking information is therefore broadly transferable from English, although multilingual supervision recovers a substantial portion of the remaining discrimination loss.
blocks.zh: 平等预算集合多语种监督进一步将AUROC增加到了0.741,将同文参考的差距从2.9个百分点减少到了1.7个百分点. 由于英语和集合条件都使用2 100个培训提示,这种改进来自监督的语言组成,而不是更大的注释预算。 在所有8个模型配置中,模式是一致的(参见表10)。 集合式监督改进了每个配置的AUROC,将跨型平均值从0.697提高到了0.724,从而将平均差距从4.9个百分点减少到2.2个百分点. 因此,跨语种排名信息可广泛从英语中转移,尽管多语种监督可收回所余歧视损失的一大部分。

blocks.en: 4.2 Ranking Transfers More Reliably Than Probability Scales
blocks.zh: 4.2 分级转让 更可信赖 大于概率比值

blocks.en: As introduced in Section 3.6 , AUROC measures whether a probe orders examples correctly, but not whether its scores match the underlying success probabilities. Table 2 shows that English-trained probes retain useful discrimination after transfer, while their Brier scores and ECE deteriorate substantially relative to the labelled same-language oracles. Equal-budget pooled supervision recovers a considerable portion of this loss: it reduces mean Brier score from 0.171 to 0.154 and lowers ECE for all 8 models (refer to Table 10 ), bringing both metrics closer to the oracle reference. Because Brier score measures overall probabilistic quality, this recovery may reflect improvements in discrimination and calibration; ECE more directly identifies improved alignment between predicted and observed probabilities. These aggregate metrics do not show whether the calibration loss is uniform across languages or driven by particular language shifts. The per-language reliability diagrams in Figure 2 therefore examine how the relationship between predicted and observed success changes for each target language in the Qwen3-4B model.
blocks.zh: 正如第3.6节所介绍的那样,AUROC衡量一个探测器是否正确订购实例,而不是它的分数是否与基本的成功概率相符。 表2显示,经英语培训的探测器在转移后仍然保留有用的区别,而其布赖尔分数和欧洲经委会与标注的同语言甲骨文相比严重恶化。 平等预算集合监督收回了这一损失的相当一部分:它将Brier的平均得分从0.171降至0.154,并将所有8个模型的欧洲经委会降低(参见表10),使这两个指标更接近于甲骨文参考。 由于Brier的分数衡量总体概率质量,这种恢复可能反映歧视和校正方面的改进;欧洲经委会更直接地确定预测和观察到的概率之间更好的一致性。 这些总的衡量标准没有显示校正损失是各语言的一致的,还是由特定语言的转变所驱动的. 因此,图2中的每种语言的可靠性图考察了Qune3-4B模型中每种目标语言的预测和所观察到的成功变化之间的关系.

blocks.en: The English-trained probe remains capable of ranking many target-language problems, but the mapping from its scores to observed success rates varies across languages. In particular, the same numerical prediction can correspond to different empirical success frequencies after language shift. Distributing the same supervision budget across languages produces scores that lie closer to the reliability diagonal and are more comparable across the covered language distribution. For reliability diagrams for the other models see Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 受英语训练的探测器仍然能够对许多目标语言问题进行排名,但从它的分数到观察到的成功率的绘图因语言而异. 特别是,同样的数值预测可以对应语言转移后不同的经验成功频率. 在不同语文之间分配同样的监督预算,得出更接近可靠性的分数,在所覆盖的语文分布中比较具有可比性。 其他模型的可靠性图见附录F。

blocks.en: 4.3 ETD Success-Prediction Performance
blocks.zh: 4.3 ETD 成功预测

blocks.en: Same-model probe performance is not sufficient to characterize routing because the ETD router Varshney et al. (2026) does not use each target model’s own representations. Instead, to save cost, Qwen3-4B supplies a shared representation, and a separate linear head predicts the success of each candidate target model. We therefore evaluate the ETD heads whose predictions are actually passed to the router. The shared ETD layer is layer 23, selected using the joint English–pooled validation-Brier criterion and then frozen for calibration, testing, and routing.
blocks.zh: 同型号探测器的性能不足以描述出路径,因为ETD路由器Varshney等(2026年)没有使用每个目标模型自己的表示. 相反地,为节省成本,Qune3-4B提供共享代表,一个单独的线性头可以预测每个候选目标模型的成功. 因此,我们评价ETD头部,它们的预测实际上传递给路由器. 共享的ETD层为第23层,采用英语-集合验证-Brier联合标准选择,然后被冻结用于校正,测试和路由.

blocks.en: Table 3: Prediction quality of the Qwen3-4B ETD routing head at the shared encoder’s reporting layer (L23), macro-averaged over the nine non-English test languages. Bold marks the best value for each metric.
blocks.zh: 表3:共享编码器报告层(L23)的Quen3-4B ETD通路头的预测质量,在9个非英语测试语言上宏观平均. 粗体标出每个度量的最佳值。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that English-trained ETD heads retain some useful ranking information, with mean rollout AUROC 0.684. Nevertheless, pooled supervision improves mean AUROC to 0.734 and reduces mean Brier score from 0.181 to 0.152. The routing advantage of pooled supervision therefore cannot be attributed to calibration alone: pooling improves the overall probabilistic predictions, including their discrimination.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,英语培训的ETD头部保留一些有用的排名信息,平均推出AUROC 0.684. 尽管如此,集合监督改进了AUROC的平均值为0.734,将Brier的平均得分从0.181降至0.152. 因此,集合监督的路线优势不能仅仅归因于校正:集合可以改善总体概率预测,包括歧视。

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of probability scaling, we apply a positive-slope variant of Platt scaling ( Platt, 1999 ) to each English-trained target-model head using pooled multilingual validation counts (Appendix G ). This transformation preserves within-model rankings, and hence AUROC, while allowing the probability scale to change. Recalibration reduces mean Brier score from 0.181 to 0.169, but pooled raw predictions remain better at 0.152. Calibration metrics generally improve after recalibration, although not uniformly for every target model. This ablation therefore shows that correcting score scales helps, but does not reproduce the full effect of multilingual supervision.

blocks.en: 4.4 Pooled Supervision Produces Stronger Routing Trade-offs
blocks.zh: 4.4 联合监督产生更强有力的平衡

This test success is slightly below the anchor because the matching constraint is enforced on validation; it does not guarantee an exact match after transfer to the test set.

blocks.en: Neither the English probe nor its recalibrated variant meets the anchor-matching criterion on validation. Nevertheless, recalibration increases their validation-selected maximum test success from 80.8% to 85.0%. Correcting the probability scales therefore improves routing substantially, but does not fully recover the pooled router’s performance.
blocks.zh: 英国探测器及其重新校正的变体都不符合关于验证的锚比标准. 尽管如此,重新校正使其所选的验证最大测试成功率从80.8%提高到85.0%. 因此,修正概率表可大大地改善路由,但不能完全恢复集合路由器的性能。

blocks.en: Across the routing grid, recalibration closes 26% of the English-to-pooled utility-regret gap (95% CI: 10.4–38.9%). Calibration thus explains part, but less than half, of the pooled advantage. Because pooling also improves ETD AUROC, its routing benefit comes from both better rankings and more reliable probability estimates.
blocks.zh: 在整个线路网中,重新校准关闭了26%的英至池的公用事业监管缺口(95% CI:10.4-38.9%)。 因此,校正可以解释部分但还不到一半的集合优势。 由于集合还改进了ETD AUROC,其路由效益既来自更好的排名,也来自更可靠的概率估计.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This work investigated whether pre-generation success probes can support cost-aware model routing across languages. Using 3,000 mathematical problems in ten languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we found that English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination, meaning they can continue to rank likely successes above failures after language transfer. Their numerical predictions, however, do not preserve the same probabilistic meaning across languages. Equal-budget pooled multilingual supervision improves both discrimination and calibration, producing success estimates that are more reliable across languages and candidate models.
These improvements translate into stronger routing decisions. The pooled multilingual router reaches 86.6% test success while saving 13.0% relative to always using the highest-average-success model, and saves 22.9% at its validation-selected anchor-matching operating point. Monotonic recalibration substantially improves English-trained predictions but recovers only about one quarter of the routing-utility gap, indicating that the benefit of multilingual supervision cannot be explained by calibration alone. Overall, our results demonstrate that transferable rankings are necessary but insufficient for multilingual routing.
blocks.zh:
这项工作调查了生产前的成功探测器是否能够支持跨语言的具有成本意识的模式通路。 我们使用10种语言的3000个数学问题和8个开放量模型配置,发现英语训练的探测器保留了有用的跨语言区分,这意味着它们可以在语言转移后继续将可能的成功排在失败之上. 然而,它们的数值预测并不保留不同语言的相同概率意义. 平等预算集合多语种监督既能改善歧视和校正,又能产生不同语文和候选模式更可靠的成功估计。
这些改进转化为更强有力的路线决定。 集合多语种路由器达到了86.6%的测试成功率,同时相对于总是使用最平均成功率最高的模型节省了13.0%,在其验证选择的锚地匹配操作点节省了22.9%. Monotonic再校正大大地改善了英语训练的预测,但只恢复了路由-用法差距的四分之一左右,表明多语种监督的好处不能单靠校正来解释. 总体而言,我们的结果表明,可转移排名对多语种路线是必要的,但还不够。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study is limited to mathematical reasoning, these findings might not extend to other domains. Nine of our ten languages are machine-translated rather than natively authored, so results reflect transfer across translated prompts. We restrict our analysis to linear probes at a single post-prompt position and do not probe during generation, which may have an impact, especially under extended reasoning traces. We evaluate only open-weight models up to 20B parameters, and larger or closed-weight models may behave differently. Finally, our routing costs are estimated under a simplified model rather than measured from a live deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究仅限于数学推理,这些发现可能不会扩展到其他领域. 我们的10种语言中,有9种是机器翻译的,而不是本地编写的,因此,结果反映了翻译提示之间的转移。 我们的分析仅限于单个后即时位置的线性探测器,在生成过程中不进行探测,这可能会产生影响,特别是在延伸推理痕迹下. 我们只评价可达20B参数的开量模型,而更大的或闭量模型可能表现不同. 最后,我们的路线费用是根据一个简化模式估算的,而不是从现场部署中衡量的。

blocks.en: Appendix A Translation Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: 附录A 翻译质量评估

blocks.en: We compare translation quality using the reference-free Unbabel/wmt22-cometkiwi-da model ( Rei et al., 2022 ) . COMET-Kiwi assigns a relative quality score based on the semantic adequacy of a translation with respect to its English source. The scores are useful for comparing and ranking the two translation systems, but their absolute values do not correspond to an independently interpretable level of translation quality. We score all 3,000 problems in each target language for both DeepL ( DeepL SE, 2026 ) and Qwen3.5-27B Qwen Team (2026) . The latter was prompted using the below provided prompt. DeepL obtains a slightly higher mean COMET-Kiwi score than Qwen3.5-27B (see Table 5 ), and its translation were therefore selected for our experiments.

blocks.en:
Consider a balanced dataset containing two equally large groups of problems.
Generations for the “easy” group succeed with probability 0.75 0.75 , while
generations for the “hard” group succeed with probability 0.25 0.25 . The
overall success rate is therefore 0.5 0.5 . Table 6 compares three hypothetical probes.

blocks.en: The overconfident and well-specified probes have identical AUROC because they produce the same ordering: both assign larger scores to easy problems than to hard problems. AUROC cannot reveal that the first probe’s probabilities are too extreme. ECE distinguishes them by comparing their numerical predictions with the observed group frequencies.
blocks.zh: 过度自信和规格明确的探测器有相同的AUROC,因为它们产生相同的订单:两者都给容易的问题分配比硬问题更大的分数. AUROC不能显示第一个探测器的概率太高。 欧洲经委会通过将其数值预测与观察到的组频率进行比较来区分它们。

blocks.en: Conversely, the constant and well-specified probes both have zero ECE. The constant probe predicts the correct overall prevalence and is therefore calibrated in aggregate, but it cannot distinguish easy from hard problems and has AUROC 0.5 0.5 . Thus, calibration alone does not establish that a predictor is informative.
blocks.zh: 相反地,不断进行和精心规定的探测器都没有欧洲经委会。 恒定探测器预测出正确的总体流行率,因此被校准为总和,但无法轻易地区分出困难问题,并且具有AUROC 0.5 0.5. 因此,单靠校准并不能确定预测器是否具有信息性。

blocks.en: Finally, the constant and overconfident probes have the same expected Brier score despite failing for different reasons. The constant probe is calibrated but uninformative, whereas the overconfident probe is discriminative but miscalibrated. AUROC and ECE reveal this distinction. NLL additionally exposes the severity of the overconfident errors: assigning probability zero to an event that occurs produces an infinite logarithmic penalty. In practice, we clip probabilities only for numerical evaluation, resulting in a finite but still large penalty.
blocks.zh: 最后,恒定和过度自信的探测器尽管由于不同的原因失败了,却有着相同的预期的布赖尔得分. 恒定探测器被校正了却不灵验,而过度自信的探测器则具有歧视性但被误判. 亚欧办和欧洲经委会揭示了这种区别。 NLL额外暴露了过度自信出错的严重性:将概率为零用于发生事件会产生无限对数惩罚. 在实践中,我们只为数字评价剪接概率,结果造成有限但仍是大处罚.

blocks.en:
Success varies substantially across both models and languages. English has the
highest average success rate across models, followed by Chinese and French,
whereas Swahili and Telugu have the lowest averages. Increasing model capacity
or reasoning effort generally improves success: performance rises across the Qwen3 model sizes, from Qwen3.5-4B to Qwen3.5-9B , and from gpt-oss-low to gpt-oss-high . Nevertheless, the language gaps remain visible even for
the strongest configurations. For example, gpt-oss-high decreases
from 0.925 in English to 0.647 in Swahili. These results reinforce that success
is conditional not only on the underlying problem and target model, but also on
the language in which the problem is presented.

不仅取决于根本问题和目标模式,而且取决于
说明问题的语言。

blocks.en:
Monotonic recalibration reduces the English heads’ mean Brier score to
0.169. Because this transformation is strictly increasing
within each target-model head, it preserves the corresponding AUROC while
correcting systematic shifts in probability scale. Its improvement therefore
isolates the contribution of calibration. Nevertheless, the raw pooled heads
retain the lowest mean Brier score, and recalibration does not improve every
calibration diagnostic for every target model. Multilingual supervision
therefore contributes information that cannot be recovered by applying a
single post-hoc monotonic correction to English-trained predictions.

success values across candidate models rather than ranking examples for one

within-model AUROC can produce poor decisions when its score scale is not
comparable with those of the other target-model heads.

blocks.en:
To isolate the effect of probability scaling, we recalibrate the predictions
of each English-trained ETD target-model head using the pooled multilingual
validation set. We fit a positive-slope Platt-scaling transformation ( Platt, 1999 ) : p ^ cal = σ ⁡ ( a m + softplus ⁡ ( b m ) ​ logit ⁡ ( p ^ raw ) ) , \widehat{p}^{\,\mathrm{cal}}=\sigma\left(a_{m}+\operatorname{softplus}(b_{m})\operatorname{logit}\left(\widehat{p}^{\,\mathrm{raw}}\right)\right), where a m a_{m} and b m b_{m} are fitted separately for each target model m m .
Predictions are clipped to [ 10 − 7 , 1 − 10 − 7 ] [10^{-7},1-10^{-7}] before applying the logit.
